# PR #3882 — keep the write-prompt setup steps when the prompt is downloaded

Tracking: [#3882](https://github.com/Blockcast/paperclip/pull/3882) · follows [BLO-20366](https://paperclip.blockcast.net/BLO/issues/BLO-20366) and [#3876](https://github.com/Blockcast/paperclip/pull/3876)

**Files:** `src/server/job-manifest.ts`, `src/server/job-manifest.test.ts`

The runtime-prompt handoff (BLO-20366, #3876) replaced the `write-prompt` init container's whole command with the downloader, so the shell steps that share that container never ran: the per-run isolation-root `mkdir`s on the `/runtime-cache` emptyDir, the Chrome BrowserMetrics link, the tool-child RLIMIT files and the `mcp.json` copy. Every `claude_k8s` run then died at startup with `mkdir: cannot create directory '/runtime-cache/paperclip-runs/<run>/workspace': Permission denied` (production incident 2026-11-25, deployed 13:45Z, rolled back 14:05Z).

The fix runs every setup step first and the downloader last, in one `sh -c`, with `exec` so a failed download still fails the init container, and gives the node downloader 128Mi (the opencode adapter's figure; busybox paths keep 64Mi). Deployed 2026-11-25 16:18Z and verified on live pods: the per-run directories are owned by uid 1000 and no run failed in the first 30 minutes.

The full account, including how the fix was verified, is in section 2 of [`blo-20366-runtime-prompt-api.md`](./blo-20366-runtime-prompt-api.md), which landed with the change. That section was appended to an existing entry, and the `policy` check (BLO-35109) wants a new file per change, so this file is the PR-keyed record.
